{% blocktrans trimmed %} Dear participant, {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} Thank you very much for taking part in this economic experiment. The experiment is intended to take about 40-50 minutes. The study aims at testing (i) economic preferences and risk taking; (ii) the extent to which these preferences can be explained by the participants' socioeconomic background, cognitive abilities, and non-cognitive abilities; and (iii) if these preferences differ between individuals active in different professions. {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} You will be asked to make a series of financial decisions. No background knowledge or specific experience is required to participate. Your answers and results will be handled such that unauthorized persons will not be able to access them. Statistics Sweden (SCB) will combine the results from the experiments with registry data using the login codes, construct a data set, and make it available to the involved researchers. {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} The data set will not contain the name, social security number or detailed information about the place of residence or the location of the workplace. Only the involved researchers will have access to the data. The researchers will not be able to identify the participants. The University of Gothenburg is ultimately responsible for managing your personal data. The study has been approved by the regional ethical review board in Gothenburg. {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} You will receive financial compensation for your participation. The exact amount depends on the choices you make and chance. All participants receive 100 SEK and you can earn up to 650 SEK. The amount will be transferred to you via bank transfer. The payment will be handled by the survey company Enkätfabriken ( http://www.enkatfabriken.se/). In order to complete the payment, the survey company will ask you to enter the login number (therefore save the invitation letter containing this number), name, social security number and bank account details. This information will not be linked to other data. When you complete the experiment, you will be linked to https://enkat.net/ekonomiskapreferenser to register your information. We will inform the survey company about how much that shall be paid to your login number and the payment will be made within two months. The compensation is taxable and the survey company will report all payments made to the tax authorities. {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} Thank you very much for participating! {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} Martin Holmen (University of Gothenburg)
Felix Holzmeister (University of Innsbruck)
Michael Kirchler (University of Innsbruck and University of Gothenburg)
Matthias Stefan (University of Innsbruck)
Erik Wengström (Lund University)
{% endblocktrans %}
